Name: (CF) Dottore Furniture - Genshin Impact
Author: NeonSystem
Description:
A small mod using assets from CometBoba's mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18341/]Dottore NPC[/url]! I pretty much just converted their art to a CF mod, and added a few extra things in as well. You can find all items in the "other"/"decor" category of the furniture catalogue, or in Robin's Shop. You'll find the Webtorre mask in the paintings/wall art section, however.

Mod includes:
Mr.Cyclops
Ruin Guard
Dottore's Webtorre Mask
Monster plush (Dottore's "monster" form in the Scara storybook)
Small and large fluffy bois (what are they even called?) ((the lil black puffball things from the Scara storybook))
A sleeping fluffy boi
Dottore's regular mask (in theory you should be able to place it on a table, which was my original intention for the item, but for me the item just gets placed [i]under[/i] the table for some reason... and afaik that's an issue with CF, not this mod...)

[size=5][b]Please note: if you want to place furniture outside, you'll need to use CF 0.12.0, because for some reason you can't do that with the latest version (version 1.14.3).[/b][/size][size=4][b]

[/b][/size][size=3]All artwork was made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/188284710]CometBoba[/url]﻿, while a couple items were merely adjusted by me. However, Dottore's regular mask (the one that [i]should[/i] be able to be placed on a table) was made entirely by me.

[/size]
